── NARROWED + SLICE UNPARKED 2026-10-06 (ADR-1708, owner ruling). The Sites slice is built now on the Space page blocks, ahead of the full editor, with danieltyack.com first: phase 1 LIVE-741 (the site renders at /sites/<slug> with a publish switch), then host routing in proxy.ts, the danieltyack.com binding, site SEO and caching, each its own row. This row keeps what that slice leaves: self-serve domain binding through the Vercel API, a free subdomain on any paid plan, and site templates. Its probe is unchanged.

2026-10-06 (LIVE-821): probe narrowed to a migration that ADDS a custom_domain column. The custom domain add-on migration (20270346004350) admits 'custom_domain' as a subscription item_key, which the old any-mention match read as the column and flipped this row to done. The row's open scope is unchanged.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const hit=fs.readdirSync("supabase/migrations").some(f=>/add column[^;]*\bcustom_domain\b/i.test(fs.readFileSync("supabase/migrations/"+f,"utf8")));const host=/custom_domain|customDomain/.test(fs.readFileSync("proxy.ts","utf8"));if(!hit||!host){console.error("PROG-E10: no tenant can serve a custom domain: "+(hit?"":"no custom_domain column in any migration; ")+(host?"":"proxy.ts does not route by custom domain")+" (EDITOR-ARCHITECTURE §8 E10 gate).");process.exit(1)}'
verify.note: Measures the E10 gate (a tenant serves a custom domain off the same registry) at its two necessary seams: a custom_domain COLUMN added in a migration and host routing for it in proxy.ts. Narrowed 2026-10-06 (LIVE-821) to an `add column` statement, so a migration that only names the custom domain add-on's item_key does not read as the column.
